IRON YARD — one owner-authorized PUBLIC FPS update (12 November 2026).

The owner requested continued improvements to the EXISTING PUBLIC IRON YARD
experience, with no private alpha or duplicate game. This one-shot request
covers merged PR #32, commit ef0865211d6b3247afd69d213f4fae6715ac27db.

Cache each procedural or PBR imported weapon primitive's cosmetic animation
role when the part is equipped or a validated LOD is swapped. Reuse numeric
motion roles rather than repeatedly parsing part.Name during each mobile
render step. Preserve all existing transforms, original PBR magazine tilt,
ADS centering, reload synchronization, bolt/slide/pump motions, and muzzle
and ejection sockets. The five-weapon executable Luau equivalence suite,
weapon integration checks, compiler, and Rojo build passed on the PR and
on merged main.

Release only after full green CI for the exact authorization commit. The
guarded PUBLIC Roblox workflow must independently verify original owner,
universe and root place, PUBLIC status, exact source SHA, and current CI.
Publish only that existing experience, never a new or private universe.
Do not claim measured Android FPS, Roblox Studio visual verification or
deployment until corresponding evidence exists. No secrets in source.
